title: Catatumbo Lightning - Rayo del Catatumbo (24335489591).jpg
author: Fernando Flores from Caracas, Venezuela
description: The Catatumbo Lightning is an atmospheric phenomenon in Venezuela. It occurs only over the mouth of the Catatumbo River where it empties into Lake Maracaibo. The frequent, powerful flashes of lightning over this relatively small area are considered to be the world's largest single generator of tropospheric ozone en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catatumbo_lightning
